item.title: Heavy rain lashes Mumbai, several areas flooded
item.description: Heavy rainfall caused flooding in low-lying areas of Mumbai on Monday. The BMC issued a red alert as Hindmata junction saw knee-deep water.

item.title: Chennai flood: Adyar river overflows, 500 families evacuated
item.description: Heavy rain led to Chennai flooding. Adyar river overflowed its banks near Kotturpuram, prompting rescue operations.

item.title: Delhi thunderstorm kills 2, uproots trees in South Delhi
item.description: A sudden thunderstorm with lightning struck Delhi late Sunday evening, killing two people in Mehrauli and knocking down trees near Saket.

item.title: Rajasthan dust storm: Jaipur and Jodhpur hit by sandstorm
item.description: A massive dust storm engulfed Jaipur and Jodhpur reducing visibility to near zero on major highways. Winds gusting at 70 km/h.

item.title: Market update: Sensex rises 300 points on positive global cues
item.description: Indian stock markets opened higher on Monday with the Sensex gaining 300 points.

item.title: Kolkata rainfall: Waterlogging in Park Street area, traffic snarls
item.description: Kolkata received over 95mm rainfall in 3 hours. Waterlogging reported in Park Street, Gariahat and Ultadanga. IMD red alert issued.

item.title: Bengaluru fog: Airport delays as visibility drops to 200m
item.description: Dense fog shrouded Bengaluru early morning causing at least 12 flight delays at Kempegowda International Airport.
